thesis: The speaker argues that his early career in investment banking and financial services venture capital was self-serving and focused on fee streams and transactions rather than the long-term value creation he initially idealized. He explains that the events of 9/11, specifically his wife's experience in the World Trade Center, prompted him to quit these roles and reevaluate his life's direction.
